author: /root/construct_integer_witnesses
claim: One actual arbitrarily late prefix witness satisfying all three original CRT residues and scalar/guard bounds under explicit concrete component-return and good-region inputs.

obligations.name: Original CRT source
obligations.required_input: All original coprimalities, gcd Mminus L = 16, and h0 divisible by 16.
obligations.constructed_input: PrimeCRTAssembly.compatible_primary_depth is called with those inputs unchanged.
obligations.justification: No fallback coprimality or altered residue convention is introduced.

obligations.name: Complete residue coverage
obligations.required_input: Zero modulo Pi^e Mminus, one modulo Mplus, and h0 modulo L simultaneously.
obligations.constructed_input: A single CRT seed r and positive step Pi^e Mminus Mplus L.
obligations.justification: Every modulus divides the common step and progression_modEq retains its distinct original residue.

obligations.name: Component-return propagation
obligations.required_input: The actual seed and step must belong to the same identity component.
obligations.constructed_input: An explicit m a in G^0, m divides L and h0; the L-congruence forces m divides r.
obligations.justification: component_step_mem is applied separately to r and k, not inferred from one to the other.

obligations.name: Factor 64 and doubling
obligations.required_input: The source preparation uses 64m and may measure a doubled generator.
obligations.constructed_input: 64m a = 32(m(2a)) in the same group; both 64m divisibilities retained.
obligations.justification: No silent identification of elliptic/coherent quotient groups is used; concrete return membership remains a displayed hypothesis.

obligations.name: Positive-tail and chosen point
obligations.required_input: The actual mixed progression must meet a good real region arbitrarily late.
obligations.constructed_input: The same k and translate r a enter component_positive_tail, and h = r+k t.
obligations.justification: Step closure equals G^0 by the monothetic theorem; target intersection with G^0 is explicit, not replaced by nonemptiness in the ambient product.

obligations.name: Exact real carrier and index map
obligations.required_input: Original coherent orbit topology and original arithmetic point H = [h]P.
obligations.justification: Nat/Int multiples are compared explicitly; both embeddings, one common h and the h-1 translation are retained.

obligations.name: Scalar and guard normalization
obligations.required_input: Original |Norm uH| > 1/(100 sqrt(7)) and all four rational trace guards.
obligations.constructed_input: good uses exact original scalar threshold and epsilon_j < absolute guard on Fin4.
obligations.justification: scalarNorm_orbit and guard_value identify values at the selected orbit point with the original rational coefficients; all epsilon_j are positive and fixed before prime data.

obligations.name: Literal source consumer
obligations.required_input: One assignment preserving q and original signed roots must use the selected h.
obligations.constructed_input: witness q labels h, first51 rows, H nonzero, all four emitted_root_fixed equalities.
obligations.justification: guards_iff and witness_rows consume exactly the h selected by CRT/recurrence; no independent charts or sign choices enter.

obligations.name: Remaining arithmetic and verification
obligations.required_input: Full completeness needs concrete return modulus, good component region, prime/local data and all remaining source rows.
obligations.constructed_input: These remain explicitly open; only the conditional joining theorem is claimed.
obligations.justification: Unchanged copies are bound; R2 V-addition repair and new sources still await hosted validation. No acceptance or full theorem is inferred from policy checks.

revision.reason: Prove DecidableEq implementation coherence instead of expecting definitional equality.

orbit_bridge_repair.changes: Definitional zero-pair exposure and correct scalar/point order of the existing homomorphism theorem; no theorem hypotheses or conclusions changed.
